blocks.content: Quiz: What makes the Rapid Building methodology tool-agnostic?
Tap an option below to answer:
It uses only open-source tools that are freely available
Tool availability is not what makes the methodology transferable. The thinking pattern is the transferable part.
Tool availability is not what makes the methodology transferable. The thinking pattern is the transferable part.
Claude Code works with all major frameworks and languages
Framework compatibility is a Claude Code feature, not what makes the methodology work across different tools.
Framework compatibility is a Claude Code feature, not what makes the methodology work across different tools.
The structure - product decisions, design, chunk prompts, commits - lives in the process, not the tool
Correct. Because planning, design, and prompt architecture are done before touching any tool, the methodology works regardless of which AI coding tool you use.
Correct. Because planning, design, and prompt architecture are done before touching any tool, the methodology works regardless of which AI coding tool you use.
All AI coding tools generate identical output for the same prompt
Different AI tools produce different results. The methodology's value is in how you prepare and structure the work, not in the output being identical.
Different AI tools produce different results. The methodology's value is in how you prepare and structure the work, not in the output being identical.
